questions.answer:

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Doing it all with a friend meant a lot for the experience.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: really easy. The accomodation provided all the information i needed .

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: i got picked up in the airport and checked in at the accommodation even though it was late. i also got a little goodie bag with usable informations.

How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: different kinds of dorm rooms - both smaller apartment constallations and normal hall single rooms.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: communal kitchens in the basement

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer:
some places you will have to buy all your own kitchen utilities.
the housing options are very different, and if you want to meet a lot of new people it is a better idea to choose the single dorm rooms because theres so many possssibilities to meet people in the communal kitchens.

How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: pretty hard to figure out a first, but once you get it is okay.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: i had to find courses on the webside for the university that interested me and that had the right information. this took a long time. When i had found the right courses it was really easy to apply.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: they invited all exchange students to a zoom meeting where they explained how to do it

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: i got the ones i applied for.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Have patience and take your time to understand the new systeme. it will make it easier in the long run.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: i was really happy with 2 out of my 4 courses. the 2 others i didn't like because of the culture difference in the education system and because of the professors.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Very different from course to course. I took one course on first year level which did not challenge me at all.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: the biggest difference were definitely the testing culture and that there was a lot of smaller papers during the year, which for me made the whole thing much more stressing.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Sociological theory SOCIOL 200
Narratives of social change COMMS 212
Sociology of gender and families SOCIOL 207
Cultural studies and society SOCIOL 100

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I will recommend Sociological theory and Narratives of social change- Both professors were really good and interesting. They were very different but i got a lot out of both courses.
